people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: They rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone on the water, and the Moabites saw the water opposite them as red as blood.
translations.bsb: When they got up early in the morning, the sun was shining on the water, and it looked as red as blood to the Moabites across the way.
translations.kjv: And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood:
translations.asv: And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water over against them as red as blood:
